examples.title: Example 1: Playing an Animation Using Images of the Resource Type
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to play an animation using the ImageAnimator component with images of the Resource type.

examples.title: Example 2: Playing an Animation Using Images of the PixelMap Type
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to play an animation using the ImageAnimator component with images of the PixelMap type.

examples.title: Example 3: Enabling Automatic Pause on Invisibility
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use monitorInvisibleArea to automatically pause the ImageAnimator component when it becomes invisible and resume playback when it becomes visible again. This behavior is controlled based on the component's state being set to AnimationStatus.Running.
